title: Classic Algerian Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional North African dish made with tender chicken and rich spices, served over fluffy couscous.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic pot over medium heat
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine
Add the Algerian spice blend and stir to combine
Add 1 cup of water and bring the mixture to a boil
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through
Serve over couscous, garnished with fresh parsley and lemon wedges
